nodes.question: Has the image background been changed into a recognizable basketball court?
nodes.criteria: complete: the background visibly reads as a basketball court, supported by court-specific visual evidence such as a court floor with boundary or court markings, and/or a hoop integrated into a court setting. A full or expansive court view is not required. Basketballs, a hoop, or a dark basketball-themed backdrop alone do not establish a recognizable court. partial: the background has visibly changed toward a basketball setting, but the evidence does not yet make it recognizable as a court. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: image evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Base the status on visible image evidence, not confidence or an assumed expected result.
nodes.binding: The edited image background, compared with the source background, as the target of the requested change to a basketball court.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
